slides.text:
The Accuracy-Cost-Latency Pareto Curve
1. High Accuracy Regime: require ~99%+ accuracy, price insensitive
• e.g. financial data room extraction
2. Low Cost Regime: require 1M docs per day, accuracy above min threshold
• e.g. offline indexing a petabyte of Sharepoint data for retrieval
3. Low Latency/Low Cost Regime: require parsing massive volumes in seconds, price sensitive
• e.g. real-time file uploads to Cowork
VLM-based approaches are primarily good for latency-insensitive batch processing.
They are not great in the agent loop.

VLM-based approaches are primarily good for latency-insensitive batch processing.

The Accuracy-Cost-Latency Pareto Curve
1. High Accuracy Regime: require ~99%+ accuracy, price insensitive
* e.g. financial data room extraction
2. Low Cost Regime: require 1M docs per day, accuracy above min threshold
* e.g. offline indexing a petabyte of Sharepoint data for retrieval
3. Low Latency/Low Cost Regime: require parsing massive volumes in seconds, price sensitive
* e.g. real-time file uploads to Cowork
VLM-based approaches are primarily good for latency-insensitive batch processing.
They are not great in the agent loop.
